basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka is filling 1 post of District Manager (Institutional & Capacity Building, Social Inclusion & Social Development) in Kolar at a pay of 30000. content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka
content_sections.text: NRLM Karnataka is the organisation named on this job opening. The post works on mobilising vulnerable and socially excluded groups into Self Help Groups and their federations, in coordination with the Block Mission Management Units (BMMU) and the State Mission Management Unit (SMMU) named in the duties. The listed place of work is Kolar district.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, so the same conditions apply to the single vacancy. Qualification: Full time PG in Social Science, Rural development /MSW/MBA/Agriculture Science or Equivalent discipline. Experience: Min 5 Years of Experience in relevant field. Age: Minimum 18 years, maximum 45 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties for the District Manager: Identify stakeholders such as vulnerable and socially excluded groups, women, differently abled, SC/STs, minorities and other underprivileged sections (as per the SECC-Auto-inclusion and deprived families) and mobilise them into Self Help Groups and their federations. Undertake field visits proactively, with a minimum of 20 days of field work. Co-ordinate households and the BMMU team for implementation of Mission activities at block level. Roll out the Micro Plan process for the community and their institutions. Facilitate credit linkage support to SHGs through timely disbursement of Community Support Fund (such as Start-up fund, RF, CIF, VRF) and Bank Linkage. Liaise with banks and other financial institutions at the district level, specifically commercial banks, to foster the SHG bank linkage programme and ensure greater financial inclusion. Support Community Federations in layering activities such as social security and development, convergence, livelihoods activities and partnership. Identify and develop Community Cadre by providing proper handholding support. Conduct training need assessment, develop training materials, and plan and implement training for community based organisations and community cadre. Work as master trainer for BMMU, community, community institutions, community cadre and other stakeholders. Extend cooperation and support to external agencies in proper implementation of Baseline, Midterm and End Term surveys. Document case studies of best practices, success stories and innovations of Social Mobilisation and Institution Building in the district, and share them with SMMU for replication in other districts. Strengthen communities on the social mobilisation and institutional building component, with special emphasis on the gender agenda. Prepare the Vulnerability plan (VRP) and the VRF released to SHGs / GPLFs. Prepare gender case studies and submit them to SMMU. Facilitate VPRP preparation and submit it to GPs. Take up any other task allocated by the competent authority.
